_why: The harness scores every other guard in h-mad, so a hole here is invisible everywhere else. These target the machinery that turns 'something went red' into 'the named test bit' -- the discrimination `ALL_CAUGHT` structurally cannot express -- plus the anchor hints and the byte-compatibility of the summary line existing callers parse. Each mutation names the one test it is aimed at, which is also this feature dogfooding itself.

mutations.name: ignore-the-named-test-and-score-the-whole-suite

mutations.name: a-wrong-catcher-counts-as-a-kill

Re-anchored on the `elif` after the collection-error branch was added: anchoring on the branch condition made this a DUPLICATE of `credit-a-collection-error-as-a-kill` and it survived its own pinned test.

mutations.name: drop-the-red-pin-precheck

mutations.name: half-wired-spec-is-accepted-silently
mutations._mechanism: A `test` with no `target_command` would fall through to whole-suite scoring while the spec claims a per-test verdict that was never computed.

mutations.name: accept-a-non-string-test-field
mutations._mechanism: A non-string nodeid would reach subprocess argv and fail as a launch error, which scores as red -- a fake kill.

mutations.name: drop-the-near-miss-hint

mutations.name: near-miss-matches-the-whole-multiline-anchor
mutations._mechanism: Comparing a multi-line `find` against single lines finds nothing useful, so every hint degrades to 'no near miss' while looking implemented.

mutations.name: guess-a-near-miss-at-any-distance

mutations.name: ambiguous-anchor-gets-no-line-numbers

mutations.name: a-launch-failure-reads-as-green

mutations.name: identical-lines-collapse-to-one-location

mutations.name: stale-bytecode-masks-a-same-size-mutation
mutations._mechanism: CPython invalidates a .pyc on (source mtime, size). A same-size mutation inside the same mtime second reuses the stale bytecode, so the mutant never executes while the file on disk is genuinely mutated -- a false `survived` indistinguishable from a coverage gap. Measured 4/6 before the fix. Pinned by a DIRECT assertion that `_run` purges, not by an end-to-end nested run: that version depends on two writes landing in the same mtime second, and the mutation also removes the purge from the nested harness the test drives, so the test's own mechanism moves under it.

mutations.name: purge-deletes-more-than-bytecode
mutations._mechanism: A purge that removed whole __pycache__ trees, or reached outside them, would be destroying the tree it is measuring.

mutations.name: credit-a-collection-error-as-a-kill
mutations._mechanism: Measured: a syntax error exits 2 BEFORE the named test's assertion runs, and this was credited as `killed by its named test`. It proves the code breaks when broken and nothing about the property -- the wrong-mechanism family the named-test scoring exists to catch, arriving through the runner instead of another assertion.

            and not counts.get("failed") and not counts.get("error")
            and not counts.get("skipped"))

mutations.name: a-genuinely-red-pin-is-scored-anyway

Anchor widened to include the precheck_spec call above it: Task 4 added a second `except SpecError` in run_spec's sibling loop, so the bare clause is no longer unique.

mutations.name: a-run-quietly-accepts-several-specs
mutations._mechanism: `--check-anchors` widened the positional to N; if the run widens with it, a single command applies and restores mutations across several trees at once.

mutations.name: resolve-a-relative-root-against-the-callers-cwd
mutations._mechanism: Reverts _resolve_root's relative branch to cwd-relative. The spec then resolves to a different tree depending on where the harness was invoked from -- the portability defect Task 1 closes.

mutations.name: default-an-absent-root-to-the-callers-cwd
mutations._mechanism: A spec with no `root` key falls back to the process cwd instead of its own directory, so the same spec mutates different files from different cwds.

mutations.name: classify-a-real-spec-as-not-a-spec
mutations._mechanism: The classifier stops honouring _load_spec's non-empty-mutations gate, so a genuine spec is skipped by a directory sweep and its drift goes unreported.
mutations.find:
if isinstance(mutations, list) and mutations:
        return "spec", None

mutations.name: swallow-a-corrupt-spec-as-a-skip
mutations._mechanism: A file that classifies `spec` and then fails deeper validation is counted as a skip instead of a finding. The sweep then reports success while a corrupt spec's guard is unverified -- the exact blindness the classifier must not introduce.

mutations.name: stop-naming-skipped-files-on-a-successful-sweep
mutations._mechanism: Skipped files stop being named, so an operator cannot tell `swept 17` from `swept 12 and quietly ignored 5`.

mutations.name: remove-the-sibling-precheck-call-from-run-spec
mutations._mechanism: WIRE direction 1: the callee survives, the CONNECTION is cut. run_spec stops prechecking siblings and mutates a tree a neighbour's drift has already invalidated.

mutations.name: fire-the-sibling-precheck-unconditionally
mutations._mechanism: WIRE direction 2: the connection fires ALWAYS. A wire that always refuses passes the remove-the-call test just as happily as a correct one, so only this direction distinguishes them.

mutations.name: sweep-the-directory-including-the-spec-being-run
mutations._mechanism: Self-exclusion is load-bearing: including self makes the spec you ran report as a drifted SIBLING, collapsing the distinction AC-3.4 requires and making the existing REFUSED verdict unreachable for self drift.

mutations.name: precheck-failed-exits-zero
mutations._mechanism: PRECHECK_FAILED is a cannot-judge verdict. Returning zero would let a sibling precheck failure look like usable mutation evidence.

mutations.name: precheck-failed-summary-carries-mutation-counts
mutations._mechanism: The new precheck verdict must report only the sibling sweep census. Reintroducing mutation counts collapses it back into an ordinary mutation verdict.

mutations.name: specerror-sibling-counts-as-drifted
mutations._mechanism: A sibling that declares itself a spec but fails deeper validation is unreadable, not anchor drift. Counting it as drifted makes drifted=0 impossible for the unreadable-only refusal this verdict was split out to name.
